title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
slides: Can Walmart win the AI agent war Amazon started?
Amazon just blocked third-party AI shopping agents
Walmart now lets ChatGPT buy for you directly
Your checkout flow must support agent traffic next
Pick one: open your store or defend the gate
thread_text:
1. The gatekeeper moved

Amazon just blocked third-party AI shopping agents from its store. That's not a product update — it's a moat being dug in real time.

2. Walmart opens the door

Walmart now lets ChatGPT buy for you directly. Same AI, opposite strategy: one closes the API, the other hands over the checkout.

3. Two business models

Amazon keeps the customer relationship and kills agent access. Walmart rents its shelf to the agent and takes the transaction. Both are bets on who owns discovery.

4. Your checkout is next

If agent traffic becomes normal, your payment flow needs to recognize bots as customers. Most stores still block them by default.

5. Choose your side

Look at your checkout logs this week: are agents getting through or getting blocked? That answer tells you which war you're already in.
